feeds.title: Yogamatters Blog
feeds.description: Here at Yogamatters, we are committed to living out our yoga principles both on and off the mat. We genuinely believe that yoga matters. That every body is a yoga body and that everybody can benefit from a regular yoga practice. Our team includes yoga teachers and students with a breadth of experience who are united in their passion for yoga.

feeds.title: OmStars
feeds.description: Omstars- the Yoga Network offers weekly inspiring and meaningful, free content on our blog. Here you'll find articles on a variety of topics from practice tips to recipes, powerful stories and teacher interviews. Through our blog, we hope to inspire readers to explore the transformative power of the yoga practice and lifestyle.

feeds.title: MoreYoga | MoreMind MoreBody MoreSoul
feeds.description: MoreYoga's philosophy is to bring you a higher quality of teaching due to a smaller and 'more' dedicated environment enabling you to thrive as a student.

feeds.title: Movement for Modern Life Blog
feeds.description: Movement for Modern Life believes in supporting the very best yoga teachers, meditation, mindfulness and movement classes so they can help to share their practices which have helped me so much.

feeds.title: Yoga with Dora
feeds.description: Welcome, my name is Dora. I am living in the UK with my husband and 3 children. I am passionate about all things Yoga and Ayurveda. My life's mission is to introduce these wonderful systems to students, to help them nurture their body, mind, and spirit by clearly and compassionately guiding them through a yoga practice that is skillful, intelligent, and enjoyable.

feeds.title: Deva Yoga
feeds.description: Deva is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Heavenly Divine. Anything of excellence' It is also refers to a Deity, God or simply a Celestial being. Our passion is to make yoga available to everyone, young and old, men and women, children and teens. We have small classes, wich allows our team of professional and gifted teachers to support, guide and assist you to get the most out of your practice.

feeds.title: Yoga Inspires - Life. One Breath at a Time
feeds.description: Yoga Inspires is a thriving community of kind-hearted women who are interested in yoga and meditation. Women who want to enhance their lives and the lives of their families and community. To love more, give more, breathe and be.

feeds.title: Intelligent Yoga Teacher Training
feeds.description: Subscribe us to keep up with the latest Scaravelli inspired yoga news, events and interesting articles here at the Intelligent Yoga Training Course (IYTT)

feeds.title: Babycrowyoga my yoga journey
feeds.description: Babycrow is a fledgling yogini living in UK. Blogs, like yoga practice, simply reflect a moment in time and are always a work in progress, and babycrow is very aware that many of her thoughts will remain half-formed for some time while she catches up with herself: her understanding of yoga, like her execution of asanas, is changing all the time.

feeds.title: Aura Yoga
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Geri and I began practising yoga in the early 1970's watching Lynn Marshall on TV. Yoga really is a 'Science for Life' that has and continues to sustain me. Yoga is an integral part of my life and I'm passionate about practising and teaching Yoga. I aim to always keep my classes welcoming, relaxed and fun. The main objective is not to tie yourself in knots but to 'un-tie' them.

feeds.title: Yoga Local
feeds.description: Yoga Local is a heart-centred full-of-integrity business with two big, fat and juicy aims: To add value and improve people's worlds through the tools of yoga (mindful movement, conscious living and no-nonsense nutrition). and to provide an online home-to-roost for wellness seekers and providers at Yogalocal.co.uk

feeds.title: Balance + Glo Blog
feeds.description: Balance + Glo's educational wellbeing hub answering your questions about yoga, fitness, lifestyle, skincare, and overall health.

feeds.title: AkramYoga
feeds.description: Akram Hot Yoga is NOT a style of yoga. Akram Hot Yoga is the name of our yoga sanctuary. We don't claim to offer you a style of yoga you have not seen before. Our studio attempts to remain true to the traditions of yoga whilst at the same time embracing that yoga has evolved over time.

feeds.title: Green Lotus Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Yoga Teacher Trainings, workshops and retreats with Carol Murphy.

feeds.title: YogaUnlimited
feeds.description: Discover how your body's natural state is light, fluid, supple and flexible. Learn how to be strong without the need for strength leading to a very different experience of moving with ease and balance.

feeds.title: Yoga by Gillian
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Gillian and I fell in love with yoga at 21, when I attended my first Ashtanga class in Dublin, Ireland. From here, I established a regular at-home practice that mainly focused on the physical aspects of yoga. I'm a yoga teacher who loves yoga and tries to live by these two mottos: Practice what you preach and preach what you practice. I can and I will.

feeds.title: theyoga
feeds.description: Yoga blog articles and inspiration including yoga poses, asanas, philosophy, wellbeing, videos and links from Susannah Dean Ramponi.

feeds.title: Special Yoga Training
feeds.description: Welcome to the Special Yoga Blog! Here you'll discover stories from the Special Yoga team and our practitioners that give you an insight into what we do and the wonderful community of people we support.We provide Special Yoga therapy to kids with special needs and offer certified teacher training to help more children embrace their potential

feeds.title: Good Times Yoga Blog
feeds.description: This Blog gives a view of yoga from a student's point of view! That's me! I have been teaching since 2012 but always learning. I love being part of the yoga world. I write about the top teachers, yoga shows, festivals, studios and workshops, and the promise of yoga's self discovery. In this blog I include retreat information, workshop recommendations and Yoga In The News.

feeds.title: Yoga With Olivia
feeds.description: Olivia takes a modern and science based approach to yoga. Expect clear instructions and a logical approach to postures that might on the surface seem complicated.

feeds.title: The Journey of my practice | A journey with no end in sight
feeds.description: I live north of London, UK. I crave a better work- Life (Yoga) balance, it's getting there, work part time and practice every day.Love my Ashtanga practice,it has kept me going and at times has been the reason I have opened my eyes and carried on

feeds.title: Alice Bowmaker
feeds.description: I have been working as a Personal Trainer for 6 years (qualifying with YMCA Fit London) and a Yoga Instructor for 5 years (qualifying with Cat Kabira). Alongside this I am attuned to working with Reiki energy. My personal and professional mission is to unveil the secrets to living and embodying the true radiant self with a feminine approach.

feeds.title: Roller Yogi
feeds.description: Yoga teacher, rollerskater, rollerderby enthusiast & a giant nerd. In an ideal world I'd be on a yoga mat with wheels on my feet.

feeds.title: Anna Macedo Yoga Blog
feeds.description: I have a natural love of teaching that I hope is evident in my classes. I see myself as a professional Yoga teacher. I take my responsibilities as a teacher very seriously. I adhere to my professional body's guidance carefully. I undertake ongoing professional development. It also means I take great care as a ]teacher to take care of my students and to ensure their individual improvemen

feeds.title: Village Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Natasha teaches on a one-to-one basis in her private yoga room in Birling and specialises in dealing with back issues and teaching pre and post natal yoga on a one to one basis. Natasha also taks about yoga for injuries, hatha yoga and much more on her blog.

feeds.title: Yoga-and-mindfulness
feeds.description: I have been a yoga student since my early 20's, I was living in London and had a stressful job and lifestyle - so attending yoga classes became my sanctuary.Well that was 26 years ago and here I am still teaching and of course still studying and learning as yoga is a way of life and life long journey.

feeds.title: Yoga with Alison
feeds.description: I've realised Yoga is not a luxury but a way of life that promotes harmony. To share with you the wonder, peace and joy I have felt through Yoga classes, would be a great privilege indeed.

feeds.title: TammysYoga Blog
feeds.description: Real flow yoga is a yoga teacher training 200-hour course accredited by the yoga alliance professionals. The course takes place in Portugal and East Sussex. Our mission is dedicated to creating inspiring and adaptive yoga teachers.

feeds.title: Tammys Yoga | all-things-yoga blog
feeds.description: Senior yoga teacher pilates wellbeing pre & postnatal expertise trains others to become yoga teachers.

feeds.title: Stillpoint Yoga London blog
feeds.description: A wonderful yoga space in the heart of London Bridge unveiling the timeless wisdom of yoga. The traditional Ashtanga Vinyasa method of yoga brings strength and flexibility to the body but more importantly relaxation and clarity to the mind. Scott reflects on popular posts from the Stillpoint Yoga London blog to help give you a fresh perspective on your practice for the new year.

feeds.title: YogiYoga
feeds.description: A friendly boutique studio located in the heart of Wandsworth. Our desire is to offer yoga and pilates for all abilities and to make our classes inclusive and accessible. Our wish is to bring an oasis of peace and calm into the local community, a space to unwind, relax, cultivate a healthy lifestyle and meet like-minded people on our blog

feeds.title: Fern Ross Yoga
feeds.description: I first discovered yoga in 2007, when I first moved to London to pursue my first career as a journalist. At the time, I was working long hours and late nights, and cycling miles and miles across the capital each week. Yoga provided a welcome relief to the pressures of the hectic newsroom. That one class had me hooked, and yoga was a constant as I worked my way up the journalism ladder.

feeds.title: Live Love Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Yoga teacher, personal trainer and massage therapist, helping to improve your health and wellbeing through simple lifestyle changes, support and commitment.

feeds.title: Mummy Yoga | The most precious thing in life is life.
feeds.description: MummyYoga is the first dedicated studio based Yoga practice exclusively for mummies in Chester. This venture was born with a singular aim, to empower women with the physical, mental and emotional strength for preparation into motherhood.

feeds.title: Surrey Yoga Therapy
feeds.description: Surrey Yoga Therapy aims to help you discover optimal wellbeing through yoga practices specifically tailored to your body, your lifestyle and your needs. A yoga therapy blog exploring how yoga can help us to manage a variety of physical and mental health concerns, and restore optimal wellbeing and balance.

feeds.title: Children Inspired By Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Children Inspired by Yoga was created by interactive designer, yoga-teacher and entrepreneur Sam Petter. Whilst on maternity leave Sam dreamt of a class for her baby son where the fun and magic of childhood were ignited whilst learning new skills for life and remaining true to her ethical principals

feeds.title: Frog Project Blog
feeds.description: The Frog Project is here to bring yoga and community to people from the comfort of their own homes. From live online yoga to yoga philosophy, lifestyle and practice, read yoga articles from our blog. They are regularly updated, inspiring reads.

feeds.title: Beinspired Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Beinspired's intention is to inspire and empower individuals to realise their true potential in life so that they can lead more fulfilling lives. In so doing, Beinspired hopes that people may live more conscious, authentic and creative lives, in touch with their truth, standing up for what they believe in and making a positive difference to their relationships and to the world.

feeds.title: The YogaLondon Blog
feeds.description: YogaLondon is a dedicated yoga teacher training school offering a diverse range of Yoga Alliance accredited programmes. We teach in a non-dogmatic way, encouraging trainees to find their own authentic style whilst still respecting the yoga tradition

feeds.title: Triyoga
feeds.description: Triyoga is a centre of excellence for yoga, Pilates and treatments. We believe that yoga is the best practice for mental, emotional, physical and spiritual wellbeing, and that yoga is not just what we do on the mat, but how we live our whole lives. Read our latest blog posts from the experts in holistic health and wellbeing at triyoga. From yoga to recipes to philosophy, find our wellbeing advice

feeds.title: All You Yoga
feeds.description: Coming to you with love from Nottingham, a yoga blog containing musings on life, anatomy and physiology, yogic philosophy, clean eating and well being. Also, lots of rambling.

feeds.title: LIZ DAFFEN YOGA | Breathing. Movement. Mindfulness.
feeds.description: Yoga can mean different things to different people and no matter who you are you can reap some benefits. I generally teach Vinyasa Flow yoga which offers a combination of flowing movements and holding poses that help to improve both cardiovascular fitness and muscle strength.

feeds.title: Yoga Rose
feeds.description: Rose Ann has been practicing Ashtanga yoga since 2005 and over the years it's taken her to London, Thailand, Goa and the home of Ashtanga, Mysore in Southern India. Rose Ann is dedicated to teaching traditional Ashtanga yoga and loves sharing her knowledge and experience.

feeds.title: Yes Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Yes Yoga blog for nutritious recipes, birth stories and yoga chat. You'll find writing and ramblings about motherhood, well-being and much more.

feeds.title: Natalie Cristal Morrison Blog
feeds.description: Natalie is a yoga teacher, meditation guide, health coach, and advocate for social change for the well-being of society and the environment. Her approach blends ancient and contemporary practices that cultivate our vitality, mental and physical awareness and our connection with the world

feeds.title: WannabeYogi - Yoga | Wellbeing | Life
feeds.description: I'm a journalist, writer and blogger who has practised many different styles of yoga on and off for more than two decades in London, Manchester and Bristol, where I now live. WannabeYogi was born from wanting to combine my love of writing with my love of yoga. Welcome to my WannabeYogi, my yoga, health and wellbeing blog.

feeds.title: Bespoke Yoga | | Tara Sellars
feeds.description: Through my training with the British Wheel Of Yoga you will be secure in the knowledge that I have undergone professional training. I'm qualified to guide & teach you expertly & safely. Anyone can practise Yoga, you don't need to be flexible! The more you practice you will notice the changes: greater strength & flexibility ,improved posture, manage stress, injury prevention & some 'me' time.

feeds.title: YOGADOO
feeds.description: YOGADOO was started in 2015 by Qualified UK Yoga Alliance and RKY Yoga Instructor, Lucy Aston. YOGADOO teaches Yoga and Mindfulness to children, young people and adults in communities and schools across Bath and Bristol.

feeds.title: Yoga United Blog
feeds.description: If you're interested in yoga and care who made your yoga kit, welcome to yogaunited and our own brand, yogamalai. We go to India every year to visit the individuals who lovingly make our products, we take groups on yoga holidays, and love talking about yoga, related practices, India, ethics, energy, colour, and style. Read our blog to know more
